title: perplexity: _convert_message_to_dict drops AIMessage.tool_calls and raises on ToolMessage
author: rbuchmayer-pplx

comments.author: vansvan17
comments.body:
I'd like to fix this. ChatPerplexity._convert_message_to_dict needs two changes matching langchain-openai's pattern:
1. Add a ToolMessage branch that returns {'role': 'tool', 'content': message.content, 'tool_call_id': message.tool_call_id}
2. Include tool_calls and invalid_tool_calls in the AIMessage branch, setting content to None when tool calls are present (OpenAI format)

Can I be assigned?

comments.body: I have a fix ready at #37919 (was auto-closed by the issue-link check). Could a maintainer assign this issue to me so I can reopen the PR?
